dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: #Have you been well, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Strange anecdotes, rumors of evil spirits... If you come across such news, please remember to share them with me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Hmm. If you ask me, it would be a nice place to settle down in.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: This realm isn't as cool as the snowy mountains, but I don't need to worry about being scorched by the sun or sudden temperature changes.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: I can concentrate on training since there's no need to worry about the effects of my yang energy.

choices.text: Not going to go outside and walk around?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If I do, I have to carry a parasol around and keep an eye on the sun.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Anyway, thank you for inviting me to such a cozy place...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If you need anything from me, I'll help out.

choices.text: Looks like I won't have to worry about evil spirits in here.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Naturally. I can assure you of that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Alright. I actually just had an infuriating experience.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: It went like this. Not too long ago, I heard someone talking about a book called "Anecdotes of Demons and Oddities." I spent a lot to buy a copy.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Who would've thought that this book was all about some dastardly, immoral villain!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: It was really hard to control my anger.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: It took half a day to get my breathing and blood pressure under control.

choices.text: Not quite what was said on the label, huh?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: The label...? No, I wasn't bothered by the book's title.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: What made me angry was... How could there be such an atrocious person on this earth!?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If I ran into them, I'd definitely...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Whoa, whoa... Calm down.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A book's plot is usually made up by its author.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: You mean... this person isn't real?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: But the plot's twists and turns felt like they were unfolding right before my eyes!

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: You don't mean... I mistakenly believed...

choices.text: It's alright, it just means that the author writes very well.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: *sigh* I'm sorry... I made a fool of myself.

choices.text: I'll go explain what happened and help you return the book.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: That's not it. It's not a matter of Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Uhh... I'd like to invite you to... eat two-flavor hot pot with me.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: You know, because of my constitution, I can't eat food until it has completely cooled down.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: I've always thought it was a pity... that I was unable to eat at the same time as you...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: After much deliberation, I finally thought of a solution in two-flavor hot pot.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: A partition is placed onto a steaming Liyue-style pot to divide the soup into two sides.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: This way, I can enjoy a light soup base even if you have Jueyun Chili soup as yours.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Also, hot pot ingredients are usually thinly sliced, so I can quickly cool them down in a bowl of ice water before eating.

choices.text: Alright, sounds like it'll be fun.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: You... you already agreed...?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: I—In other words, we can go soon...?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your face is really red...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: I... I'm fine. I just...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Everything went better than I thought. I'm a little too happy... I'll be fine in a moment...

choices.text: I can have light soup together with you if you like.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Uh... Uhh...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Cooking in the same pot...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Chongyun.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Do you have any plans today?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: If you're looking to train today, or hunt evil spirits, I'll definitely accompany you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Chongyun.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: You head to bed first. Don't worry, I'll rest after another round of practice.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Phew... This is the last round for today...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: How did you know that I was worrying about finding a place to practice?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Simple tents... and a traveler's pack... Practicing here would be great.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Good thinking, setting this up around your house. Many thanks for the trouble you went to.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: After returning from a long journey, it would feel nice to rest here before heading out again.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Weapons can go there, and Sigils can go under my pillow. Mm-hmm.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: But where should I put my parasol... I suppose I'll just put it by the door.
